s: Din hashkamat habboqer ubo y"t seipim: yitgabber kaari laamod babboqer laabodat boreo yitbarek, shellekak nibra, ulekak machazir lo nishmato. Veap im yesitennu yitzro lemor: adayin lo sabata mishshenateka — yitgabber alayv laqum, sheyyehe hu meorer hashshachar. Veyachashob belibbo lipne mi hu shokeb, veyeda shemmelek malke hammelakim haqqadosh-baruk-hu chopep alayv, shenneemar: "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male neum Hashem", veillu haya shokeb lipne melek basar vadam sheomed alayv haya mitchayyeb benapsho — qal vachomer lipne melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh-baruk-hu. Velaken yaqum miyyad bizrizut laabodat boreo yitbarek veyitalleh. Veal yomar: hineni shokeb bemittati veelmod — ella yaamod veyilbosh malbushayv, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon liqrat eloheka yisrael":

Veken yachshob bekol asaqayv veinyanayv, ki en yeshibat haadam utenuotayv vaasaqayv vehu lebaddo bebeto kishibato utenuotayv vehu lipne melek gadol, veen dibburo veharchabat piv kirtzono vehu im anshe beto uqerobayv kedibburo bemoshab hammelek. Kol shekken kesheyyasim haadam el libbo, shehammelek haggadol, melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh-baruk-hu, asher "melo kol haaretz kebodo", omed alayv veroeh bemaasayv, kemo shekkatub: "im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Hashem" — miyyad yaggia elayv hayyira vehahaknaa mippachad habbore yitbarek, veyebosh mimmennu tamid:

Velo yitbayyesh mippene bene adam hammaligim alayv baabodat boreo yitbarek. Umikkol maqom, lo yaaneh dibre azzut keneged hammaligim, shello yiqneh qinyan benapsho lihyot az panim apillu shello bimqom abodato yitbarek:
Veim eno yakol lehashkim qodem or habboqer — mikkol maqom lo yeacher zeman hattepilla shehatztzibbur mitpalelin:

Tob lomar miyyad kesheyyeor mishshenato: "modeh ani lepaneka melek chay veqayyam, shehechezarta bi nishmati bechemla, rabba emunateka". Veen tzarik lazeh netilat yadayim, ap im yadayv metunnapot, mippene sheen qedushsha betebot nussach zeh, kevan sheen bo shum shem (ayyen siman pah) mehashshemot sheenan nimchaqin. Abal asur lehotzi dibre tora mippiv im lo natal yadayv adayin, mippene shebbattebot atzman yesh bahen qedushsha. Abal muttar leharher bedibre tora beyadayim metunnapot:
Hanneor mishshenato veamad tekep umiyyad al raglayv — hu qarob lemita yoter min hachayyim, ella yishheh meat qodem sheyyaamod:

Ap-al-pi shemmiddin hattalmud en tzarik littol yadayv tekep umiyyad keshenneor mishshenato, ella rashshay lehallek benetayim, veken muttar middin hattalmud ligga bemalbushayv qodem netilat yadayim — mikkol maqom chakme hazzohar hizhiru meod shello lelek apillu arba ammot qodem netilat yadayim shacharit, veken hizhiru shello ligga bemalbushayv qodem netilat yadayim. Vekol yere shamayim yachamir leatzmo kedibre hazzohar. Vekol medaqdeq bemaasayv yizzaher shemmiyyad shenneor mishshenato yittol yadayv ap-al-pi shennishar mushkab, ubazeh yinnatzel mehotzaat shikbat zera lebattala:

Tob lehashkim qodem or habboqer, lehitchannen lipne boreo. Vetob sheyyitchannen beshaot shemmishtannot hammishmarot, shehen: lesop shelish hallayla, ulesop shene shelishe hallayla, velibsop hallayla, shebbeellu hazzemannim haqqadosh-baruk-hu zoker lechurban bet hammiqdash veku', laken hattepilla sheyyitpallel haadam beotah shaa al hachurban vehaggalut — retzuya uqeroba lehitqabbel. Laken rauy lekol yere shamayim sheyyehe metzer vedoeg beotah shaa velishpok tachanunim al churban bet hammiqdash, kemo shekkatub: "qumi ronni ballayla lerosh ashmurot". Umikkol maqom hattora vehattepilla tzarik lihyot besimcha, kemo shekkatub: "ibdu et Hashem besimcha". Veyesh laasoq battora shebbeal peh. Vetob lechabber yom valayla betora o bitpilla, hen babboqer hen baereb:
Tob meat tachanunim bekavvana — meharbot shello bekavvana. Veken betalmud tora. Umi sheyyesh lo leb lehabin lilmod — tob lo lilmod milleharbot betachanunim, ki talmud tora gadol meiyyun tepilla:

Tob lomar bekol yom parashat haaqeda, kede lizkor zekut haabot lipne haqqadosh-baruk-hu, vegam kede lehaknia yitzro laaboda[t] hashshem yitbarek kemo shemmasar yitzchaq napsho; uparashat hamman, kede sheyyaamin shekkol mezonotayv bain lo behashgacha, shekken haya bamman shehishgiach haqqadosh-baruk- hu latet lekol echad "omer laggulgolet" lekol napshot beto, kemo shekkatub: "vayyamoddu baomer velo hedip hammarbeh vehammamit lo hechsir"; vaaseret haddibberot, sheal yede ken yizkor maamad har sinay bekol yom vetitchazzeq emunato. Ubiqqeshu chakamim liqboa aseret haddibberot biqriat shema, ubittelum mippene hamminim, shello yomru leamme haaretz sheen shear tora emet, vetedeu sheen qorin ella mah sheamar haqqadosh-baruk-hu veshameu mippiv besinay. Lepikak asur leomram betzibbur derek qebiut bekol yom, apillu shello betok birkot qeriat shema ella qodem "baruk sheamar", raq kol yachid muttar liqrotam leatzmo. Velaken en nohagim gam ken lekotbam al qunetres meyuchad latztzibbur, mippene hamminim:

Ameru chakamim: kol haoseq betorat ola — keillu hiqrib ola, vekol haoseq betorat chattat — keillu hiqrib chattat. Lepikak, tob lomar bekol yom parashat haola , umincha, ushelamim, vetoda, vechattat, veasham vadday, veasham taluy, veqorban oleh veyored, dehaynu parashat "veshoma qol ala vego'". Ulepi shekkol qorban habba bindaba taun nesakim, lepikak achar ola ushelamim vetoda — yomar parashat nesakim, abal chattat veasham en teunim nesakim:

Im yodea shennitchayyeb chattat — yomar techilla parashat chattat veachar-kak parashat ola, mippene shehachattat mekapperet legamre al oto avon shehi baa alayv, vehaola hu doron, veyesh lehaqdim hakkappara qodem haddoron, sheqqodem sheyyitratztzeh el hammelek — lo yeqabbel haddoron:
Parashat haqqorbanot — lo yomar ella bayyom, lepi sheen maqribin qorban ballayla. Abal parashat hakkiyyor uparashat terumat haddeshen kevan shehayu naasim ballayla — yakol leomram qodem or hayyom:
Tzarik lomar parashat haqqorbanot meummad, veken "mizmor letoda" — dugmat haqrabatan shehayeta meummad:

Kesheyyesayyem parashat haola — yomar: "yehi ratzon millepaneka, sheyyehe zeh chashub umequbbal lepaneka keillu hiqrabti ola". Vekak yomar achar parashat hammincha vehashshelamim vehattoda, mippene shehem baim bindaba ap im lo nitchayyeb bahem. Abal lo yomar kak achar parashat hachattat vehaasham vadday vetaluy veqorban oleh veyored, shemma lo nitchayyeb bahen — vahare zeh kemaqrib chullin baazara, lepi sheen baim bindaba. Umikkol maqom achar parashat asham vadday vetaluy — yomar: "im nitchayyabti asham vadday vetaluy, yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyehe zeh chashub ku'", sheakshav im lo nitchayyeb bahen — en qeriato chashuba kehaqraba kelal, vahare hu keqore battora. Abal achar parashat chattat — lo yomar ken, lepi sheim en hu yodea beberur sheabar abera shechayyabin aleha chattat — eno yakol lehabi qorban, ap-al-pi shebbeemet abar abera shechayyabin aleha chattat, veim hebi — en mitkapper lo, ella im ken hayeta lo techilla yedia berura shechata, shenneemar: "o hoda elayv chattato". Veyesh nohagin lomar gam achar parashat chattat: "im nitchayyabti ku'", ki shemma noda lo shechata vechazar veshakach:

Beshabbat veyom tob — lo yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyehe zeh ku'", lepi sheen qorbenot hayyachid qerebim beshabbat veyom tob, abal happarashiyyot en hepsed leomran keqore battora. Umikkol maqom im eno am haaretz — mutab sheyyaasoq beparashat hayyom:
Beereb happesach ubechol hammoed shel pesach ubeereb yom hakkippurim — lo yomar parashat toda, mippene shello hayeta toda qereba bayyamim hahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman takat vetarad:

Tob lomar im haqqorbanot pasuq: "veshachat oto al yerek hammizbeach tzapona vego'", mippene sheyyesh bammidrash: amar haqqadosh-baruk-hu meid ani alay shamayim vaaretz, beshaa sheqqorin miqra zeh "tzapona lipne Hashem" — ani zoker aqedat yitzchaq ben abraham:

Yesh nohagin lomar parashat hakkiyyor, veachar-kak parashat terumat haddeshen, veachar-kak parashat hattamid, veachar-kak parashat mizbeach miqtar qetoret, veachar-kak parashat sammane haqqetoret vaasiyyatan, ki kak haya seder haabodot bammiqdash:
